```python
import requests
import re

orcids = ['0000-0001-6102-7846', '0000-0002-0209-2784', '0000-0002-1053-2030', '0000-0002-2605-6569', '0000-0003-0396-0333']

YEAR_RE = re.compile(r'>\s*(19\d{2}|20\d{2})\s*<')

def count_pre2020_from_static(orcid):
    url = f'https://orcid.org/{orcid}'
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        r.raise_for_status()
        html = r.text
        years = [int(y) for y in YEAR_RE.findall(html)]
        # Count only years strictly before 2020
        pre2020 = sum(1 for y in years if y < 2020)
        return pre2020
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Warning for {orcid}: {e}')
        return 0

results = {}
for o in orcids:
    results[o] = count_pre2020_from_static(o)
print(results)
```
